MLOps Engineer, AI Trading Platform
Vertex Trading Labs — Remote (Global)

About us
Vertex Trading Labs builds machine learning systems for crypto market making and on-chain analytics. Our trading signals run on a 24/7 inference platform and our research team ships models weekly.

What you'll do
- Build and operate model training and serving infrastructure for trading signals.
- Run MLflow and Kubeflow pipelines on Kubernetes; manage GPU clusters and CUDA drivers.
- Serve LLMs and ranking models with vLLM and Triton; optimize inference latency.
- Own distributed training jobs with PyTorch, Ray and HuggingFace.
- Build feature stores and vector databases for RAG and fine-tuning workflows.
- Automate data pipelines with Airflow, dbt and Kafka; store data in ClickHouse and Postgres.
- Deploy on AWS with Terraform, Docker and GitHub Actions.
- Monitor training and serving with Prometheus, Grafana and SLO-driven operations.

Requirements
- 4+ years of MLOps, ML platform or AI infrastructure experience
- Strong Python and SQL; Go or Rust is a plus
- Production experience with MLflow, Kubeflow and model serving
- Hands-on with CUDA, GPU scheduling and distributed training
- Experience with LLM, RAG, fine-tuning and RLHF
- Feature stores and vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone)
- Airflow, Kafka, ClickHouse and Postgres
- Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform and AWS
- Prometheus, Grafana and SLO-driven operations

Nice to have
- Solidity and smart contracts
- Ethereum, MEV or market data experience
- HSM or custody integration

Benefits
- Remote-first with quarterly onsites
- Research budget for GPUs and conference travel
- Competitive salary and token grant
